description: Codex lifecycle gate for final-answer review

hooks.command: if [ -f "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/gate.mjs" ]; then node "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/gate.mjs"; hook_status=$?; [ "$hook_status" -eq 2 ] && exit 2; fi; exit 0
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$root = $env:PLUGIN_ROOT; if ($root) { $gate = Join-Path $root 'hooks\gate.mjs'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $gate -PathType Leaf) { & node $gate; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 2) { exit 2 } } }; exit 0"
